title: St. John of Damascene on Holy Images (Followed by Three Sermons on the Assumption)
author: damascus
attributionNote: Recorded in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library under John of Damascus, St. (c. 675-749). The site catalogues the work at https://ccel.org/ccel/damascus/icons, whose own card names the print edition transcribed here; where the site carries a title by a publisher's permission rather than in public domain, this library does not take it.
description: St. John of Damascene on Holy Images (Followed by Three Sermons on the Assumption) — the English text the Christian Classics Ethereal Library publishes for this work, on the site's Early Church shelf. The record was created by the CCEL import from the site's own catalogue and plain text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's catalogue, whose shelves follow the site's own division of Christian literature, and whose transcription follows the print edition London: Thomas Barker, 1898.
availabilityNote: Complete in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's plain-text edition: 1 chapter(s), 226 paragraph(s), 904 words. The divisions are the headings of the site's own text, which the library stores rather than asking the site for again when the work is read. The text is public domain and is displayed with the library's credit.
